Repair request policy, peer selection, dedup cache, and latency-based peer tracking.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_policy` interface for the Repair agent. It declares the data structures and helper functions used to choose which missing shreds to request, which peer to ask, and when to avoid duplicate requests by using a time-based dedup cache. It also defines peer tracking, including round-robin selection, latency buckets, request and response counters, and shared-memory construction and join/leave functions for the policy state. The file mainly provides type definitions, constants, inline key helpers, and function prototypes for the repair selection logic.
